mechanism: Clotrimazole inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially reducing primaquine metabolism and increasing its plasma concentrations, which may elevate risk of hemolytic toxicity in G6PD-deficient patients.
action: Monitor for signs of hemolysis (jaundice, dark urine, fatigue); consider alternative antifungal if possible; ensure G6PD status is known before co-administration.
